summary: Implemented the endpoint-resolver builtin helper. Changes: (1) botocore/regions.py: added `import enum` and the EndpointResolverBuiltins(str, enum.Enum) class with 11 members, each with a meaning/type comment. (2) botocore/args.py: imported the enum as EPRBuiltins; added ClientArgsCreator.compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults after _ensure_boolean, composing the bridge's FIPS and DualStack lookups and the existing STS and S3 predicates; made _should_set_global_sts_endpoint accept endpoint_config=None. (3) tests/unit/test_args.py: added TestEndpointResolverBuiltins (derived from unittest.TestCase) with tests for each behavioral criterion. Verification: the new test class passes (22 tests); the full unit suite shows the same 11 pre-existing failures before and after the change (unrelated modules such as test_awsrequest.py and test_session.py), and the passing count rose by 22. black and isort could not be run because the shared venv lacks them; line lengths were checked manually and no added line exceeds 79 columns. Nothing was committed.
